rulings.why: Refrain system 1: the main row prints 'We're march-ing to Zi-on' with nothing between; 'on' is only in the men's answering row under it ('We're march-ing on to Zi-on,'), which the reading took for stanza 2.

rulings.row: beautiful beautiful zion were marching upward to
rulings.printed: Beautiful beautiful Zion We're marching upward to
rulings.sung: Beautiful beautiful Zion We're marching upward to
rulings.why: The main refrain rows print 'Beau-ti-ful, beau-ti-ful Zi-on; We're march-ing up-ward to'; 'heaven-ly' is from the men's answering row 'heaven-ly Zi-on,' under refrain system 2, which the reading took instead.
Refrain system 2's main row prints 'The beau-ti-ful cit-y of God.'; the men's answering row under it stops at 'heaven-ly Zi-on,', so the reading that took that row has nothing here.
